text: So Musa and Harun walked into the palace of Pharaoh. The same palace where Musa had grown up.
They said: we are messengers of your Lord. Let the Children of Israel go with us, and do not torment them.
Pharaoh mocked him: did we not raise you among us as a child? And then you did what you did.
Musa showed him the signs. But Pharaoh only grew prouder.
He gathered his people and announced: "I am your most exalted lord."
And he called it all magic. We will bring you magic like it, he said. Let us meet on the day of the festival, in front of all the people.
